steps.description: Comments on the sample. We do not cut on a chat message.

steps.title: Sew and count

warranty.title: When a size or stitch misses the signed sample.
warranty.description: The signed fit sample and the PO are the reference — not a verbal OK.
warranty.commitment: Measurement claims are checked against the signed size spec and the AQL sheet in the carton.

cases.question: If bulk fit drifts from the signed sample
cases.title: Hold the PO or rework against the signed block.
cases.description: Cutting starts after PP. Out-of-tolerance sizes are pulled before packing.

cases.question: If shrinkage exceeds the spec
cases.title: Wash test before PP.
cases.description: Wash results sit on the style sheet. Failed lots stay off the cutting ticket.

cases.question: If a carton is short
cases.title: The packing list is the count.
cases.description: Every carton is counted at final audit.
